speech.text: You stand in the entrance hall of the abandoned observatory. A dusty desk sits beside the library door.
You inspect the desk and discover a small library key. It remains on the desk until you collect it.
You pick up the library key. The library door is still locked.
The key turns in the lock. You can now enter the library, and the key remains in your possession.
The instruction manual explains the emergency beacon. Replace the fuse, start the generator, and align the beacon.
Inside the workshop toolbox, you discover a spare fuse. After inspection, you close the toolbox lid again.
You fit the spare fuse into the generator's socket. The fuse is installed, but the generator has not started.
The generator starts. Power is restored to the observatory, but the beacon still needs alignment.
The valley station receives your signal. When the storm passes, rescuers arrive at the observatory.
You shelter in the telescope chamber until morning. No rescue signal was sent. You leave when the storm clears.
